title: Nuni's Big Farm Adventure! 🐮🐷🐑 Farm Animals, Sounds & Counting for Kids

scenes.say: Hoo hoo! Good morning, friends! It's me, Nuni the little owl! Today we are flying to a very special place. Can you guess where? It's the farm! Let's go!
Here we are at the big farm gate. Look at the green grass, the tall trees and the bright yellow sun. Everybody on the farm is waking up. Shh... can you hear something?
Cock-a-doodle-doo! That's the rooster! He sits on the fence and sings every morning to wake up the whole farm. Can you sing like the rooster? Cock-a-doodle-doo!
Great job! The rooster has red feathers on his head and long shiny tail feathers. Thank you, Mister Rooster! Now everybody is awake. Let's go and meet the animals!
Who is this big friend in the meadow? She is black and white, and she says... moo! It's the cow! Hello, cow! Can you say moo with me? Moooo!
Look, the cow has a baby! A baby cow is called a calf. The calf is little and wobbly, and it stays close to its mommy. Moo, moo, little calf!
Cows eat lots and lots of green grass all day long. Munch, munch, munch! Can you pretend to munch grass like a cow? Munch, munch! Yummy!
Splish, splash! Who is playing in the mud? It's the pig! Pigs are pink, they have a curly tail, and they say oink, oink! Oink, oink, Mister Pig!
Why do pigs love the mud? Because the cool mud keeps them nice and comfy on a sunny day. Silly pig! Let's wiggle like a pig. Wiggle, wiggle, oink!
Oh look, little piglets! Let's count them together. One... two... three! Three little piglets! They're running and playing hide and seek. Oink, oink, oink!
Who is so soft and fluffy, like a big white cloud? It's the sheep! The sheep says baa, baa! Can you say baa? Baaaa!
The sheep's fluffy coat is called wool. Wool can be made into warm sweaters and cozy socks for winter. Thank you, sheep, for your soft wool! Baa, baa!
Clip, clop, clip, clop. What do you hear? It's the horse! The horse is tall and strong, and it has a long flowing mane. The horse says neigh!
The horse says Nuni can sit on its back for a gentle ride. Hold on tight! Clip, clop, clip, clop, all around the farm. Wheee! This is so much fun!
Do you know what horses love to eat? Hay, oats, and crunchy carrots! Nuni gives the horse a big orange carrot. Crunch, crunch! Thank you, says the horse. Neigh!
Cluck, cluck, cluck! That's the hen! And look who is following her... little yellow chicks! The chicks say peep, peep, peep! So tiny and so cute!
Let's count the chicks with Nuni. Ready? One, two, three, four, five! Five little chicks! Great counting, friends! Peep, peep, hooray!
The hen lays eggs in a cozy nest made of straw. Inside some eggs, baby chicks grow, and one day... crack! A little chick says peep, hello world!
Quack, quack! Who is swimming in the pond? The ducks! Ducks have orange feet that paddle in the water, paddle, paddle, paddle. Let's quack like a duck! Quack, quack!
One duck dives under the water. Splash! Where did it go? Here it is! Peekaboo, duck! The ducks love the cool blue water.
Behind the mommy duck swim the little ducklings, all in a row. Let's count them. One, two, three, four! Four fluffy ducklings! Quack, quack, quack, quack!
Who is climbing up the big hay stack? It's the goat! The goat has little horns and a funny beard, and it says maa, maa! Goats love to climb!
Woof, woof! Here comes the farm dog, wagging its tail. The dog helps the farmer and takes care of all the animals. Good dog! Woof, woof!
The dog loves to play fetch! Nuni throws a stick, far, far away. Run, doggy, run! And the dog brings it right back. Good job, doggy! Woof!
And who is sleeping in the warm sunny window of the barn? It's the cat! Meow. The cat is very sleepy. Let's whisper so we don't wake it up. Shh... meow.
Vroom, vroom! What's that big red machine? It's the tractor! The tractor helps the farmer pull heavy things and plant seeds in the field. Vroom, vroom!
This is the big red barn. Inside the barn, the animals sleep at night, safe and warm. There is soft hay, and a place for every animal friend.
Let's play hide and seek in the hay! Nuni will count. One, two, three, four, five... ready or not, here I come! Where are you, friends?
I found the piglet behind the hay! And I found the chick in the straw! Hee hee! Hide and seek is so much fun on the farm!
Now let's visit the farm garden. Look at all the colors! Orange carrots. Red tomatoes. Green lettuce. And big round pumpkins. Can you name a color you see?
The carrot is orange. The tomato is red. The lettuce is green. Vegetables help us grow big and strong. Crunch, crunch! Yummy vegetables!
Look up! It's an apple tree, full of shiny red apples. Let's count them! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Ten red apples!
Nuni picks one apple for each friend. One for the cow, one for the horse, one for the goat, and one for me! Sharing is caring!
Oh, a little rain is falling. Pitter, patter, pitter, patter. The plants drink the rain and grow. And look, after the rain... a beautiful rainbow!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple! What a beautiful rainbow over the farm. Can you point to your favorite color?
Now all the animals want to sing a song with us! Clap your hands and sing along. Ready? Here we go!
Down on the farm, the sun is bright! Moo and oink from morning light! Cluck and quack and baa, hooray! Come and play on the farm today!
The cow says moo, the pig says oink, the sheep says baa, the duck says quack! Down on the farm, hoo hoo! Let's sing it one more time!
Down on the farm, the sun is bright! Moo and oink from morning light! Cluck and quack and baa, hooray! Come and play on the farm today!
What a wonderful day! Now the sun is going down, and everybody has a picnic together. Thank you, farm friends, for playing with Nuni!
Let's remember all our friends. The cow says... moo! The pig says... oink! The sheep says... baa! The horse says... neigh! The duck says... quack! Great job!
It's time for the animals to go to sleep in the big red barn. Good night, cow. Good night, pig. Good night, sheep. Good night, little chicks.
Did you have fun on the farm? Nuni had so much fun with you! You were a great helper, counting and singing and making all the animal sounds.
See you next time for another adventure with Nuni and friends! Bye bye! Hoo hoo!
